title: MiyunaPluginManifest
description: Canonical schema definition for Miyuna Universal Plugin manifests (plugin.json).

$schema.description: URL or URI pointing to the canonical plugin manifest JSON Schema.

id.description: Unique reverse-domain identifier for the plugin (e.g. org.miyunadev.jellyfin-connector).

name.description: Human-readable display name of the plugin.

description.description: A concise summary of what the plugin provides.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-or-later) or PROPRIETARY.

homepage.description: Web URL to the plugin project homepage or repository.

icon.description: Relative path to the plugin icon inside the archive package (PNG/SVG, recommended 256x256).

miyuna.description: Semver range for the required Miyuna host bridge version (e.g. >=1.0.0 <2.0.0).

client.description: Client engine flags and minimum versions.

artifact.description: Specification of the primary executable or declarative artifact bundle.

type.description: The artifact type determining the sandbox execution model.

entry.description: Relative path within the package archive to the main entry point (no directory traversal allowed).

integrity.description: Subresource integrity hash for the main entry point (e.g. sha256-...).

contributions.description: Declared UI and logical contribution slots requested by the plugin.

id.description: Identifier for the contribution, unique within this plugin.

path.description: Relative route path for 'route' contributions (e.g. /main or /settings).

slot.description: Target UI slot for widgets or menu entries (e.g. sidebar, profile-menu, dashboard-card).

events.description: List of event topic names for 'event-listener' contributions.

providesCapability.description: The capability name provided for 'capability-provider' contributions.

capabilities.description: Declared capability and permission requests required by the plugin.

name.description: Canonical capability name identifier (e.g. storage.local, network.fetch, device.naviah-sync).

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the plugin requires this capability.

quota.description: Quota limit for storage or resource capabilities (e.g. 10MB, 50MB).

domains.description: Destination domain whitelist for network.fetch capabilities.

operations.description: Granular operation names permitted for compound capabilities.

dependencies.description: Peer plugin dependencies required by this plugin, mapped from plugin ID to semver range.
